title: Knight's Local Avatar Wearer & Changer Script Add-on [FREE]
features:
Experience what your Saved Avatars looks like in any  games on the Avatar Saver script. Made and Partnered only with Avatar Saver V2 Script's Saved Avatars.

• Experimental Script and not proven safe or will work in any games. Try or use with your own risk!

• Yes this script is not Against Filtering Enabled(FE), is Local, is Client side, is just a visual, and is a script that only you can see and experience.

• Made specifically to read and load Saved Avatars on the Avatar Saver script.

• This script is inspired by @vexuize and @dees/@hieslas's Avatar Changer script. Special mention to @1954real.

FEATURES:
- Key less and no Key systems.
- Smooth and glitch-less animation/pose across all Tried-on Avatars.
- Supports all saved avatar items including Accessories refinements or custom adjustments.
- Compact design, Destroyable, and Re-executable UI/Process/instance/Caches.
- Supports emoting.
- R6 to R15 Avatar Trying-on/Changing and vice versa.
- Advanced and Smooth Searching (Search "r6" to view r6 or r15 saved avatars).
- Built in Error Diagnostic Logs.
- Auto restore Active Try-on avatar upon death and respawn.
- And Many more micro features.

Tips:
- If you have so much saved avatar like around 200+ either on the Saver or Wearer(you will notice slight consistent fps drop), wait around a few seconds for the script to load all saved avatars. Avoid refreshing, Re-executing if not necessarily even if the script is Re-executable, it will just make the fps drop keep happening.
- Please use this script responsibly.
- Lets larp
- Respect Everyone and Yourself.
